organization_mail_from_check.name: organization_mail_from_check
organization_mail_from_check.value: "organization"."mail_from" is null or (length(trim("organization"."mail_from")) > 3 and position('@' in "organization"."mail_from") > 1)

organization_mail_reply_to_check.name: organization_mail_reply_to_check
organization_mail_reply_to_check.value: "organization"."mail_reply_to" is null or (length(trim("organization"."mail_reply_to")) > 3 and position('@' in "organization"."mail_reply_to") > 1)

organization_registration_settings_check.name: organization_registration_settings_check
organization_registration_settings_check.value: jsonb_typeof("organization"."registration_settings") = 'object' and "organization"."registration_settings" ?& array['sharedContactEmail','minimumAge','guardianRequiredBelowAge','maximumClassesPerGroup'] and ("organization"."registration_settings" - 'sharedContactEmail' - 'minimumAge' - 'guardianRequiredBelowAge' - 'maximumClassesPerGroup') = '{}'::jsonb and "organization"."registration_settings"->>'sharedContactEmail' in ('allowed','disallowed') and ("organization"."registration_settings"->>'guardianRequiredBelowAge')::int between 0 and 100 and ("organization"."registration_settings"->>'maximumClassesPerGroup')::int between 1 and 100 and (jsonb_typeof("organization"."registration_settings"->'minimumAge') = 'null' or ("organization"."registration_settings"->>'minimumAge')::int between 0 and 100)

entry_event_assigned_start_number_unique.name: entry_event_assigned_start_number_unique
entry_event_assigned_start_number_unique.where: "entry"."assigned_start_number" is not null and "entry"."deleted_at" is null and entry_category_holds_place("entry"."acceptance_category")

entry_event_requested_start_number_uniqu.name: entry_event_requested_start_number_unique
entry_event_requested_start_number_uniqu.where: "entry"."requested_start_number" is not null and "entry"."deleted_at" is null and entry_category_holds_place("entry"."acceptance_category")

entry_deleted_reason_check.name: entry_deleted_reason_check
entry_deleted_reason_check.value: "entry"."deleted_at" is null or "entry"."deletion_reason" is not null

person_deleted_reason_check.name: person_deleted_reason_check
person_deleted_reason_check.value: "person"."deleted_at" is null or "person"."deletion_reason" is not null

vehicle_deleted_reason_check.name: vehicle_deleted_reason_check
vehicle_deleted_reason_check.value: "vehicle"."deleted_at" is null or "vehicle"."deletion_reason" is not null

invoice_payment_org_provider_unique.name: invoice_payment_org_provider_unique
invoice_payment_org_provider_unique.where: "invoice_payment"."provider_payment_id" is not null and "invoice_payment"."provider_refund_id" is null

event_public_registration_rate_limit_ove.name: event_public_registration_rate_limit_override_nonempty_check
event_public_registration_rate_limit_ove.value: "event_public_registration_rate_limit_override"."event_limit" is not null or "event_public_registration_rate_limit_override"."window_seconds" is not null

organization_public_registration_rate_li.name: organization_public_registration_rate_limit_override_nonempty_check
organization_public_registration_rate_li.value: "organization_public_registration_rate_limit_override"."organization_limit" is not null or "organization_public_registration_rate_limit_override"."event_limit" is not null or "organization_public_registration_rate_limit_override"."window_seconds" is not null

public_registration_rate_limit_override_.name: public_registration_rate_limit_override_audit_target_check
public_registration_rate_limit_override_.value: ("public_registration_rate_limit_override_audit"."scope" = 'organization' and "public_registration_rate_limit_override_audit"."event_id" is null) or ("public_registration_rate_limit_override_audit"."scope" = 'event' and "public_registration_rate_limit_override_audit"."event_id" is not null)

entry_document_review_check.name: entry_document_review_check
entry_document_review_check.value: ("entry_document"."status" = 'uploaded' and "entry_document"."reviewed_at" is null and "entry_document"."reviewed_by" is null and "entry_document"."rejection_reason" is null) or ("entry_document"."status" = 'reviewed' and "entry_document"."reviewed_at" is not null and "entry_document"."reviewed_by" is not null and "entry_document"."rejection_reason" is null) or ("entry_document"."status" = 'rejected' and "entry_document"."reviewed_at" is not null and "entry_document"."reviewed_by" is not null and length(trim("entry_document"."rejection_reason")) > 0)
